name: Views Resizable Columns
description: Makes Views-generated table columns resizable by the user (drag to resize).
project_description:
Features 
 Columns in Views-generated tables using the "Table" format become user-resizable. Adjusted widths are stored locally per browser (via LocalStorage):

- Customizations apply only to the current desktop browser 

- No impact on other users’ configurations

- No synchronization across devices or browsers

- For now it doesn't work for mobile and tablet users

 Post-Installation 
 The feature activates automatically after module installation. No additional setup is required — all compatible Views tables gain this functionality instantly.
